title: Omini index fund
tagline: LayerZero-powered Omnichain index fund - seamless portfolio sync across all chains
description:
Buying In (Minting INDEX)

User Journey:
  1. Connect wallet with USDC
  2. Choose portfolio type (Growth/Balanced/Stable)
  3. Enter USDC amount
  4. Receive INDEX tokens

 Behind the scenes:
  - User's USDC is automatically split across multiple assets
  - Assets are purchased on Base, Flow, and ETH Sepolia
  - User gets INDEX tokens representing their share

2. Holding & Tracking

  - Users hold INDEX tokens in their wallet
  - Real-time value updates based on underlying assets
  - Portfolio automatically maintained at target allocations
  - No need to manage individual positions


3. Selling (Redeeming INDEX)

  User Journey:
  1. Choose to redeem INDEX tokens
  2. Select output (USDC or underlying assets)
  3. Receive funds back
